summary: String replacement panics when a match boundary splits a UTF-8 codepoint because try_replace_all_with slices the haystack using unchecked byte offsets. The fix skips such matches before slicing. The verbatim implementation reversal is identifiable, but the plan is blocked: no detecting named Rust test was found at the fixed commit. The fix adds no tests; existing replacement doctests use ASCII inputs. The existing fuzz-find target exercises replacement but supplies neither a named Rust regression test nor a committed reproducing input. No builds or tests were run.
